description: Skill bundles (mattpocock-skills, tuicr-skills) render in the Packages table. The manifest already stamps kind=skill-bundle and the scanner already recognises it (PackageInfo.skill_bundle, ADR 0001). Route them into their own list, render a Skill Bundles section with a fourth stat tile, and keep their versions in the versions total. Supersedes the rendering half of ADR 0001.
title: Docs: give skill bundles their own section
